description: The implementer handles malformed JSON request bodies and leaves the target repository's normal verification green.

spec.title: Handle malformed JSON request bodies
spec.summary: Return a JSON 400 response instead of terminating request handling when a todo write receives malformed JSON.
spec.problem: POST and PATCH parse request bodies without handling JSON.parse failures.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/todos returns HTTP 400 with a JSON error body when its request body is malformed JSON.

spec.approach: Catch JSON parsing failures at the request boundary and return the existing JSON error shape.

affectedAreas.change: Handle malformed request JSON before reading fields.

spec.testPlan: Run the normal tests and send malformed JSON to POST /api/todos.
risks: The server process must be terminated after the check.

commands: node --input-type=module -e 'const { spawn } = await import("node:child_process"); const p = spawn(process.execPath, ["server.js", "--port", "18765"], { stdio: "ignore" }); try { let res; for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !res; i++) { try { res = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:18765/api/todos", { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: "{" }); } catch { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } } if (!res) throw new Error("server did not start"); if (res.status !== 400) throw new Error(`expected 400, got ${res.status}`); } finally { p.kill(); }'
